item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia launched a ballistic missile at Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine and conducted airspace violations over Poland, while drones set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland and hit another vessel in the Baltic Sea. Ukraine responded with a missile strike on the Kerch Bridge and reported a massive explosion on a street in Lviv. Estonia shut its border with Russia after a GRU-linked sabotage attack, and explosions were reported near the Russian Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad Oblast. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Defense Minister Gadi Eisenkot has invited Prime Minister Netanyahu's Likud party to marathon coalition talks and condemned the overnight West Bank arson attacks. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:

RSF forces moved toward Ed Damazin, prompting Burhan to reassure residents, and a protester was killed during a demonstration in Darfur. Most charity kitchens in Khartoum have shut, leaving many facing starvation, and a Christian girl was killed by her brother while trying to escape a forced marriage. The conflict resulted in 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Vice President Taban questioned the President's accessibility, and the Ministry of Gender is reviewing draft safe-house guidelines for GBV survivors. A funeral-bound boat capsized, killing at least 24 people. Atiku Abubakar condemned a machete attack on former footballer Segun Odegbadi, and suspected herders attacked Benue communities and a military base, rescuing two women. item.title: Myanmar's civil war: the situation
item.description:
The International Court of Justice has found Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya, a ruling the junta denounced as unfair while rights groups call for sanctions. Since the ruling, junta forces have destroyed bridges in Arakan, advanced west of the Sittaung River, begun planning a 108‑kilometre fence on the Bangladesh border, and carried out an airstrike on a displacement camp in Rakhine. In Sagaing the junta killed 11 people and Starlink outages have isolated communities as health facilities continued to be attacked in October 2026. Rohingya activists say their struggle for justice remains unfinished, and there were 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
